segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Good evening everyone and thank you for coming to the Soccer Club meeting.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: It's good to see so many parents and children here tonight, and I know you are looking forward to a great football season.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Now I'd like to take a few minutes to tell you about some changes to the Soccer Club for the coming season.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Now, this season we'll be playing all our matches for both the junior and senior competitions at King's Park, instead of Royal Park, which was used last season.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Now for meetings, we're going to use the clubhouse in King's Park, and the next meeting will be held in the clubhouse on the 2nd of July.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: As usual, we hope to begin the season with a~ next Saturday at the clubhouse.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Please try and come to the picnic as it's always good fun.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: The last week of the season we usually have a dinner and presentation of~ to the players, and more information about this will be given to you later in the season.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: This season we have more teams than ever.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: We hope to have~ teams, instead of five, in the junior competition and they will play on Saturday mornings, beginning at 8.30 a. m.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Training sessions will be held in King's Park on Wednesday afternoons for the juniors and they will be wearing red shirts again this year.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: In the senior competition, there'll be four teams, the same as last year, and their games will be played on Saturday afternoons starting at 2.30, no sorry, it will be a 2 o'clock start, and the training session for seniors is planned for Sunday afternoons.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Now I'd like to introduce you to the new committee for the Soccer Club for this season.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Firstly, let me welcome Robert Young, the new President, who will manage the meetings for the next two years.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Robert's son has been playing football with the club for over five years now, and many thanks to Robert for taking on the job of President.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Next we have Gina Costello, she's the treasurer, and she will collect the fees from you for the season.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Please try and give Gina your fees as early as possible in the season, as the club needs the money to buy some new equipment.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Then there's David West who has volunteered to be the club secretary, and one of the many jobs he will have is to send out newsletters to you regularly.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: If you have any information that may be useful, please let David know so that it can be included in these newsletters.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Also I'd like to introduce you to Jason Dokic who is the Head Coach.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: For all the new members here tonight, this is the third year that Jason has been with us as Head Coach, and we are very lucky to have such an experienced coach and former player at our club.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: He will continue to supervise the teams, at training sessions and on match days.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Now before we finish and have some refreshments, does anyone have any questions they'd like to ask the new committee?
